seoul-south-korea-namhansanseong-ridge-l.title: Namhansanseong Ridge Loop
seoul-south-korea-namhansanseong-ridge-l.slogan: Two passes and 364 km, high point 100 m
seoul-south-korea-namhansanseong-ridge-l.story: A proper escape from Seoul with roads worth waking up for. A 364 km loop that starts and ends near Osan, about 6 h 37 of riding. scenicChapters.title: Baden bei Wien → Palace and Gardens of Schönbrunn
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 28 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
